fact: 1901年3月，J.P.摩根通过查尔斯·施瓦伯接触安德鲁·卡内基，询问其是否愿意退出实业；卡内基同意后，卡内基系合伙权益被出售并入美国钢铁公司。DBpedia记录美国钢铁公司成立日期为1901年3月2日，总部在匹兹堡，创始股东含摩根、施瓦伯、弗里克与加里。

fact: 美国钢铁公司组建触发1901年钢铁业劳资冲突：全国铁工兄弟会（Amalgamated Association）先试图扩大协议范围，失败后罢工；美国钢铁旗下各厂工人一度全部退出，数周内罢工彻底失败，工会骨干被摧毁。

sources.quote: Its next big setback, in 1901, was caused by the organization of the United States Steel Corporation... a strike resulted... all the organized men in all the mills of the United States Steel Corporation were called out, but to no avail; after a few weeks’ struggle the strike was utterly lost. The failure of the 1901 strike broke the backbone of the Amalgamated Association.

sources.quote: New York, N.Y., March 12, 1901 — I make this first use of surplus wealth, four millions of first mortgage 5% Bonds, upon retiring from business, as an acknowledgment of the deep debt which I owe to the workmen who have contributed so greatly to my success... In addition I give one million dollars of such bonds, the proceeds thereof to be used to maintain the libraries and halls I have built for our wo[orkers].

fact: 卡内基自述其爱德加·汤姆森钢厂的经营原则：随行就市的滑动工资制以“让工厂持续开工”为第一要务，对工人而言稳定就业比高工资更重要。

sources.quote: The sliding scale enables the company to meet the market; and sometimes to take orders and keep the works running, which is the main thing for the working-men.
